0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 5th in the Central and 14th in the East) in Philadelphia's third game of the 2026-27 season. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and LeBron James (back) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won their 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently beating Milwaukee 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
